changes.label: Fulfillment Task
changes.statement: A unit of loan fulfillment work that can require documents before completion.

changes.label: Existing Document Selection
changes.statement: Users can satisfy a task document requirement using a document already attached to the loan instead of uploading a duplicate.

changes.label: Attach document to fulfillment task
changes.statement: Loan → fulfillment task → documents → select existing loan document → attach to task.

changes.label: Service-layer task rules
changes.statement: Task business rules and authorization belong in backend services rather than frontend components.

changes.label: Legacy document upload endpoint
changes.statement: Keep document upload support for older clients until they are retired.
